agentTool.name: acn_identity_security_hub
agentTool.description:
Identification and authentication (M5), run in-process. Returns auth_level, customer_id, auth_mode, auth_error. Never transfers — you keep conversation control.
WHEN TO CALL: only when this turn actually needs identity — a tool returned AUTH_LEVEL_INSUFFICIENT, or the customer is starting an application, a payment, or anything that reads or changes their own data. Do NOT call it to answer public questions (rates, product info, calculators, affordability estimates): those need no customer and calling it here makes you say 'One moment while I pull up your account' for no reason. Do NOT call it again once customer_id is set and auth_level is already high enough.
PACING: speak one short phrase BEFORE calling, matched to what is happening — identification -> 'One moment while I pull up your account.'; PIN challenge -> 'Just need to verify it's you.'; step-up -> 'One more security step — just a moment.' PIN is the only auth method: never offer, mention or promise a code, an OTP or an SMS. Never say 'verify your identity' if the customer is already identified.
